summary: Multi-page website with Admin Dashboard, registration system, and themed UI. Currently applying global warm beige marble background (#DCCBB5) with dark overlay across all pages.
architectural_notes: Global body background uses warm beige marble color (#DCCBB5) with dark overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.75)) for text readability

existing_features.title: Set the global body background color to a warm beige marble tone (#DCCBB5) across the entire application by updating the global stylesheet (frontend/src/index.css). This must apply to all pages: Home, Technical Events, Non-Technical Events, Register, Payment, Success, Contact, Admin, and Dashboard.

Add a full-viewport fixed dark overlay element with background rgba(0,0,0,0.75) and z-index below all page content (z-index: 0 or equivalent) so that neon/orange glowing elements remain visually premium and text stays readable against the beige background. This overlay must not block any interactions or sit above any content layer.

Ensure that all existing layout, spacing, font sizes, animations, neon highlights, circuit patterns, CountdownTimer, Navbar, Footer, and all functional components remain completely unchanged. Only global background styling is modified.

new_feature_requests.summary: Change global background to warm beige marble (#DCCBB5) with dark overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.75)) across all pages
